column1: # Search, as Phiegg's is (puikit: app/phiegg/src/pages/phiegg/SearchPage.tsx):
# a field; before anything is sought, what is sought most often; and
# what it finds of every kind, the kind chosen by a tab.
# A tab: its name, the word of data/text.tsv on it, what it finds, the
# icon its finds carry. What it finds: `room` (the rooms of every host
# the person is in), `people`, `host` (every host), or, after `tree:`,
# a kind of Phiora's records, the very ones Phiegg reads (asked of
# Phiora where it gave the site, else read from Phiegg's own files by
# the manifest Phiora seeds from). `all` is every other tab at once.
tab
tab
tab
tab
tab
tab
tab
# What Phiora is asked for its records ({kind} the kinds, by commas).
ask
# Phiegg's manifest of its files, from this crate's folder: which file
# and which list each kind is in.
tree
# A record's own words: the first of these fields it has is its name,
# the first of the next its line.
name
line
# What is sought most often, shown before anything is: Phiegg's own,
# from its site file, the list of that name.
popular
# A record's picture: the first of these fields it has, as a key of
# Phiegg's pictures (this start, then the path, less what is left off
# its front). A record with none wears its world's: the world named by
# the first of these fields it has (an id, or a list of them), from the
# kind of this name.
picture
key
strip
borrow
world
# How many cards each kind shows under All; a kind's own tab shows as
# many as the theme's people.most.
all
# A record's page (part/record.rs): the records it is related to are
# those that name it, and those it names, by these fields; its host is
# the Phiogy host the first of these fields names.
link
host
